_documentation.purpose: Filler flowers and foliage used to complete a bouquet (gypso, eucalyptus, and so on).
conventions: Top level is an object with two keys: `_documentation` (this block, ignored by the app) and `items` (the array of records the app reads).
Prices are in Philippine pesos (PHP), stored as plain numbers with no currency symbol.
`null` means the value is not known yet. It never means zero. Check for null before doing math on a value.
Enumerated values (type, origin, occasion, mood, etc.) are lowercase, with hyphens instead of spaces where noted.
`id` values are unique and stable. Gaps in the numbering are fine, and ids should not be reused or renumbered.
`image` paths are served from the site root, so `/images/flowers/x.png` means the file `public/images/flowers/x.png`. The image files themselves have not been added yet.

fields.name: string. Display name, singular.
fields.description: string. Short two-sentence customer-facing description based on popular flower-language meanings. Gypso is also called Jepsu.
fields.stock: integer or null. 0 means out of stock (Misty is out of stock), null means not counted yet.
fields.type: string or null. `fresh` or `dried`. Not filled in yet.
fields.color: array of strings. Colors the shop stocks, lowercase (for example, red, pink, white). Three common colors per item were added as a starting point, not confirmed stock. Replace them with the shop's actual stocked colors. Used by the designer's color search.
fields.occasion: array of up to 4 strings: up to 3 main occasions, plus `just-because` where the flower suits casual, everyday affection. Allowed values: anniversary, birthday, graduation, valentines, mothers-day, wedding, undas, funeral, get-well, congratulations, housewarming, just-because.
fields.mood: array of up to 3 strings. Allowed values: romantic, loving, sweet, passionate, elegant, graceful, cheerful, happy, playful, hopeful, grateful, peaceful, solemn, respectful, welcoming, joyful, fresh, warm, sentimental.
fields.bundleSize: integer or null. Stems per bundle. Unknown for all fillers so far.
fields.bundlePrice: object {min, max} or null. Regular price of one bundle. If min equals max it is a single price.
fields.seasonalPrices: object. Season name mapped to a bundle price, for example {"undas": 380}. Empty object if there is none.
fields.active: boolean. `false` hides the item from the app (unfinished entries or placeholders). Inactive items stay in the file.

notes: Statice is sold for Valentines (occasion `valentines`). Its origin is not known yet.

items.name: Yucca
items.description: Yucca leaves add bold, structural greenery that frames the blooms in a bouquet. They symbolize resilience and protection.

items.name: Gypso
items.description: Gypso's cloud of tiny white blooms is a classic symbol of everlasting love and innocence. It softens and fills a bouquet beautifully, especially for weddings and anniversaries.

items.name: Misty
items.description: Misty adds a soft, airy haze of color around larger blooms. It is associated with remembrance and gentle affection.

items.name: Aster
items.description: Asters are small, daisy-like blooms that stand for love, patience, and faith. They are also a familiar sight during Undas as a tribute to those remembered.

items.name: Goldenrod
items.description: Goldenrod brings bright, golden sprays that stand for encouragement and good fortune. It adds warmth to cheerful bouquets and is also seen in Undas arrangements.

items.name: Statice
items.description: Statice keeps its color long after cutting, which is why it stands for remembrance and lasting love. Its papery clusters make a sweet addition to Valentine's bouquets.

items.name: Chamomile
items.description: Chamomile's cheerful, daisy-like blooms symbolize patience and comfort. They are a gentle choice for wishing someone well.

items.name: Rice Flower
items.description: Rice flower's tiny clustered buds add soft texture beside larger blooms. Many associate it with abundance and fresh beginnings, as rice itself is a symbol of prosperity.

items.name: Eucalyptus
items.description: Eucalyptus adds fresh, silvery-green foliage and a calming scent to any arrangement. It symbolizes protection, healing, and new beginnings.
